classification: Post-hoc frozen target-information ablation on previously opened crossed-study scenarios; descriptive evidence, not a fresh confirmatory scenario set.

edmdc_model.recursion: initial lift then latent propagation; unchanged

aborts.capture_before_later_abort: retain capture plus report abort separately

plant.integration: unchanged nominal nonlinear 12-state RK4 plant_step and allocator

information_modes.oracle: Saved exact scripted future physical reference; reuse all160 saved results.
information_modes.heading: atan2 of available measurement velocity; hold preceding available heading if horizontal speed<=1e-8; unwrap relative to preceding causal heading. Never use future true heading.
information_modes.physical_reference: Forecast acceleration zero; unchanged physical_reference maps forecast velocity and zero acceleration to drag-compensating attitude; forecast body rates derived only from forecast sequence. No controller weights changed.
information_modes.position_hold: Separate exploratory stationary-target/pure-pursuit reference: measured current position held; desired velocity zero (not an estimate of actual target velocity); desired roll/pitch/body rates zero; yaw fixed to initial interceptor yaw. All weights retained. No position-only cost exists; suppressing velocity weights would change selected objective, so is not done.

startup_delay: Simulator preloads target position/velocity measurements at -0.25s through -0.01s. At k=0 the delayed policy receives precisely sample -d, without any newer sample. History is simulator-owned and not exposed to policy. Initial interceptor state remains unchanged; initial yaw is the original scenario state, not a new future measurement.
leakage_guards: Pure policy signature contains only immutable Measurement, current sample, horizon, delay, mode, preceding causal heading and fixed nominal quad parameters. Sensor asserts exact sample=k-delay and logs every access. Policy never receives scenario seed, generator, ground-truth arrays or parameters. Forecasts are saved every50 updates. Capture/abort evaluator accepts true reference independently.

smoke_gate.oracle: Full20s two selected-controller replays on first straight seed; reference and initial state exact, accepted flags identical, max state/applied wrench difference<=1e-8. No numerical adjustment if gate fails.
smoke_gate.causality: Unit checks verify all three causal equations, delay ages including startup, forbidden-newer-history poisoning invariance, and position-only packet velocity absent. Eight smoke episodes on first helix seed; control-envelope aborts are retained but do not permit tuning; execution/nonfinite/leakage errors stop evaluation.
smoke_gate.scoring: Dwell rescored against true reference; predicted reference never supplied to evaluator.

analysis_plan.aggregates: Capture, full completion, aborts, solver failures, allocator events; mean/median successful qualification and sphere entry, entry speed, minimum separation, per-episode maximum absolute roll/pitch; repeat by family.
analysis_plan.paired: EDMDc-B minus Linear-A for each mode; successful-time comparisons only joint captures. Separately score every scenario, noncapture=20. Within each controller use later information condition minus earlier: oracle->CV->100ms->250ms.
analysis_plan.bootstrap: 20000 paired iid scenario resamples, percentile95 CI, seed2026100201; conditional comparisons resample joint-capture pairs only. Descriptive post-hoc intervals.
analysis_plan.wins: Negative difference is second-arm/EDMDc improvement; abs(diff)<=1e-12 tie.
analysis_plan.representative: CurrentCV both captured: choose absolute paired-time difference nearest median; ties by seed. If none, no successful representative is fabricated.
analysis_plan.figures: After results frozen, capture by condition; conditional and penalized time in separate panels; family outcomes; deterministic CurrentCV trace with true separation/speed.
analysis_plan.secondary: Only after primary report and result freeze exist. No tuning/selection on primary results. Position-only reported separately and excluded from main CV comparisons.
